draft.text: You came to the emergency room because you had chest pain and shortness of breath after falling outside.
You told us that the healthcare provider checked your blood pressure and the swelling in your ankles.
You have high blood pressure and a heart condition called mild to moderate mitral regurgitation, but you were not aware of this before.
The next steps will be discussed when you see your doctor.

unverified_summary.text: You came to the clinic because you had chest pain and shortness of breath after falling outside.
You described the chest pain as a pressure feeling in the middle of your chest that lasted a few minutes and did not spread to other areas.
You did not have symptoms like sweating, nausea, or dizziness.
You also did not notice any swelling or bruising on your chest or back after the fall.
The next steps will be discussed.
